report:
Hi there,

Since Sunday we've had no hot water at all. The heating works fine and the radiators get hot, but the taps and the shower just run cold even after ten minutes. It's the combi boiler in the kitchen cupboard. We've checked the pressure and it's on 1.5.

Thanks,
[name] (28 Queen's Terrace)
[phone]

model.summary: No hot water from taps or shower since Sunday, but heating works. Combi boiler in the kitchen cupboard, pressure 1.5 bar. Call [name] on [phone] to arrange access.

report: Tenant called 19:20. Faint smell of gas near the hob when they got home, goes away when the window's open. They haven't used the hob since.

model.summary: Faint smell of gas near the hob, noticed on returning home. Tenants have not used the hob since.

report:
Hello,

The boiler has stopped working since yesterday evening, there is no heating and no hot water. The little screen on the front says F28. I have tried turning it off and on again at the switch.

Regards,
[name]
Flat 2

model.summary: Gas combi boiler showing fault code F28; no heating or hot water since yesterday evening. Tenant has already tried switching it off and on.

report: toilet wont flush at all, handle just goes down and nothing happens. lifted the lid and the chain thing inside has snapped i think

model.summary: Toilet won't flush; tenant thinks the chain inside the cistern has snapped.

report: Hi, our carbon monoxide alarm in the kitchen keeps beeping every minute or so. Not sure if it's just the battery? The boiler is in the same cupboard. [name]

model.summary: Carbon monoxide alarm in the kitchen beeping every minute; probably needs a new battery.

report: Tenant called 09:40. Water dripping from the bathroom ceiling light fitting, thinks the flat above has a leak. She has switched the bathroom light off at the switch and put a towel down.

model.summary: Water dripping through the bathroom ceiling light fitting, probably from a leak in the flat above. Tenant has switched the light off at the switch.

report: There is black mould coming back around the window in the back bedroom and the windowsill is wet most mornings. We wipe it down but it comes back within a week.

model.summary: Recurring black mould around the back bedroom window, with condensation on the windowsill most mornings.

report: Hi, the gas fire in the living room won't light any more. It clicks but nothing happens. We don't really use it, the central heating is fine, but thought you should know. [name]

model.summary: Gas fire in the living room clicks but won't light. Central heating works. Tenant will be in on Thursday morning.

report: Hiya, the kitchen tap is dripping constantly, it's not a lot but you can hear it all night. Tried tightening it but no luck. [name]

model.summary: Kitchen tap dripping constantly; tenant has tried tightening it.

report:
Hi,

The front door lock is broken. The key turns but the latch doesn't catch any more so we can't actually lock the door. We've wedged a chair against it for tonight but we'd really like it sorted as soon as possible.

[name], 31 Queen's Terrace

model.summary: Front door lock broken: the key turns but the latch doesn't catch, so the door can't be locked. Tenants have wedged a chair against it.

report: Hi, there's mould on the silicone round the bath and the grout is going black. I've tried bleach. Not urgent. [name]

model.summary: Mould reported.

report: Half the sockets in the flat have gone off. The kitchen ones work but nothing in the living room or the bedroom. I checked the fuse box and one of the switches keeps flicking back down when I push it up. [name]

model.summary: Sockets in the living room and bedroom have no power; kitchen sockets work. One switch in the fuse box trips straight back down when reset.

report: Hi, every time the heating comes on there's a funny smell in the hall, a bit like eggs? Not strong. Also the radiator in the hall stays cold. [name]

model.summary: Smell like rotten eggs in the hall whenever the heating comes on, which may be a gas leak. The hall radiator also stays cold.

report: Hiya, the freezer drawer at the bottom is iced up solid and the fridge part is warmer than it should be, milk went off in two days. [name]

model.summary: Freezer drawer completely iced up and the fridge isn't keeping food cold (milk went off in two days). The fridge's thermostat has failed and needs replacing.

report: fridge freezer stopped working overnight. light comes on but its not cold, everything in the freezer is defrosting

model.summary: Fridge freezer has stopped cooling; the light works but the freezer is defrosting.

report: Hello, two of the storage heaters aren't coming on at all now and it's getting really cold at night. The one in the living room is fine. [name]

model.summary: Two storage heaters not coming on; the living room heater works.

report:
Hello,

I'm writing again about the mould in the bedroom. It is now on the wall behind the wardrobe and on some of our clothes. My daughter has asthma and it is making it worse. We open the windows every day. I have asked about this before and nothing has happened, I am getting very frustrated and I want to know what you are going to do about it. If nothing is done soon I will be contacting the council.

[name]

model.summary: Mould on the bedroom wall behind the wardrobe and on clothes; the tenant's daughter has asthma and the mould is making it worse. Tenant opens the windows daily.

report: Tenant called 18:15. Says there was a crackling noise and a burning smell from the double socket behind the TV in the living room. She has switched it off at the wall and unplugged everything.

model.summary: Double socket behind the TV in the living room not working.

report: Hello, the oven isn't heating up properly, it takes ages and the food comes out half cooked. The grill works fine. [name]

model.summary: Oven heats slowly and doesn't cook food through; the grill works.

report: Hi there, the hot water has gone off this morning, heating seems ok. We've got a 3 week old so it's a bit stressful! [name]

model.summary: No hot water since this morning; heating is working.

report: Hi, the bathroom window won't close properly, the handle has gone loose and just spins. It's on the first floor so it's not a security worry, just a bit draughty. [name]

model.summary: Bathroom window handle is loose and spins, so the window won't close. First floor; tenant says it isn't a security risk.

report: Hi, none of the lights upstairs are working since last night, downstairs is fine. I've checked the fuse box and nothing has tripped. [name]

model.summary: Upstairs lighting circuit has failed, probably a tripped breaker in the consumer unit. Downstairs lights work.

report: Hello, I had a letter saying the gas safety check for the flat is due next month. When will someone be coming to do it? I work from home on Mondays and Fridays. [name]

model.summary: Annual gas safety check due next month; tenant is home on Mondays and Fridays.

report: smoke alarm on the landing keeps chirping

model.summary: Landing smoke alarm chirping.

report: massive damp smell in the downstairs toilet, the wall under the window is wet to touch and the plaster is bubbling

model.summary: Damp smell in the upstairs bathroom; the wall under the window is wet and the plaster is bubbling.

report: Tenant called 14:30. Dishwasher leaking from the door onto the kitchen floor when it runs. They've stopped using it.

model.summary: Dishwasher leaks from the door onto the kitchen floor during a cycle; tenants have stopped using it.

report: 1) shower is really low pressure 2) one of the kitchen cupboard doors has come off its hinge 3) there's water on the floor under the kitchen sink every morning, I've put a bowl under there

model.summary: Low water pressure in the shower.

report: Tenant called 08:05. No power at all in the house since about 7, the whole street is fine. Trip switch won't reset. Fridge and freezer off.

model.summary: No power anywhere in the house since about 7am, though the rest of the street has power. The main trip switch won't reset.

report: Tenant called 11:05. The back door won't lock, the handle mechanism has gone and the door just swings open. Back door is the one she uses because of the step at the front (wheelchair user).

model.summary: Back door won't lock: the handle mechanism has failed and the door swings open. Tenant is a wheelchair user and relies on the back door.

report: Hello, after the storm there are a couple of roof tiles in the front garden, I think they've come off our roof. No leaks inside that I can see. [name]

model.summary: Roof tiles found in the front garden after the storm, probably from the roof. No leaks inside so far.

report: Hi, there's a lot of condensation on the windows in the bedroom every morning, running down onto the sill. No mould yet. Is there anything you can do? [name]

model.summary: Heavy condensation on the bedroom windows every morning, running onto the sill. No mould yet.

report: Hello, I'm emailing for my mum, [name], Flat 1 Station House. Her storage heaters haven't come on for two days and the flat is freezing. She's 84. Can someone come out please? Karen [name], [phone]

model.summary: Storage heaters not working for two days. Contact the tenant's daughter Karen on [phone].

report: washing machine wont drain, theres still water in the drum at the end of the cycle and it smells

model.summary: Washing machine doesn't drain; water left in the drum at the end of the cycle.

report: two fence panels blown down in the back garden in the wind last night, the dog can get out now

model.summary: Two fence panels in the back garden blown down overnight; the tenants' dog can now get out.

report: There's a sewage smell in the bathroom and when the toilet was flushed this morning the bath gurgled and some dirty water came up through the plughole. [name]

model.summary: Sewage smell in the bathroom; dirty water came up through the bath plughole when the toilet was flushed.

report: Tenant called 17:40. Strong smell of gas outside the front of the house, by the meter box. Not inside as far as they can tell.

model.summary: Strong smell of gas outside the front of the house, near the meter box. Tenant says it doesn't seem to be inside.

report: The people upstairs have their music on until 2 or 3 in the morning most nights. I've knocked but they don't answer. Is there anything you can do? [name]

model.summary: Not a repair: noise from the flat upstairs late at night.

report: Hi, the side gate latch is broken so the gate won't shut. [name]

model.summary: Side gate latch broken; gate won't stay shut.

report: Hi, we've seen mice in the kitchen, droppings in the cupboard under the sink and behind the cooker. Can you send someone? [name]

model.summary: Signs of mice in the kitchen: droppings in the cupboard under the sink and behind the cooker.

report: Hello, the key has snapped in the back door lock. Half of it is still stuck in the lock. The door is locked, we can still get in and out through the front. [name]

model.summary: Key snapped in the back door lock with half still inside. The door is locked and the tenants are using the front door.

report: Hi, just checking when my rent is due this month as the 1st is a Sunday? Thanks, [name]

model.summary: Not a repair: tenant is asking when rent is due this month.
